products.title: OrganoTex Garment Care Kit (300 ml)
products.body_html:
BioCare Sport Textile Wash
Gentle detergent for functional clothing, rainwear and shell garments. Also suitable for outdoor clothing, parkas, fleece and textile outdoor gear. Helps maintain the fabric’s water-repellent finish (DWR) and leaves no residue that impairs breathability. It also works in cold water, making it practical for hiking trips. Use before reproofing with OrganoTex waterproofing products.

Wash-In Textile Waterproofing
A wash-in treatment that restores or improves water and dirt repellency. Suitable for sports and outdoor garments made from polyester, polyamide, wool, down or blends. Check the garment’s care instructions and the treatment’s compatibility before use. Maintains the garment’s breathability, colour and feel.

Product information
The product is 100% biobased and readily biodegradable according to OECD 301F. Certified to OEKO-TEX® ECO PASSPORT and USDA Certified Biobased Product 100%.
